contentItem.title: 直线图形内接于另一直线图形
contentItem.englishTitle: A rectilineal figure is said to be inscribed in a rectilineal figure when the respective angles of the inscribed figure lie on the respective sides of that in which it is inscribed.

revision.changeSummary: Imported Heath source and machine-assisted Chinese draft. No mathematical or editorial review is implied.

surfaces.text: A rectilineal figure is said to be inscribed in a rectilineal figure when the respective angles of the inscribed figure lie on the respective sides of that in which it is inscribed.
据说,当所刻数字的角位于所刻数字的两侧时,直线数字就被刻在直线数字中。（相关点与线段：A）
